name: io.github.Servosity/comet-backup-mcp
title: Comet Backup MCP
description: Fleet-wide backup health, failure triage and usage reports for every tenant on your Comet Server

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Set the COMET_BACKUP_PASSWORD credential for the Comet Backup MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Set the COMET_BACKUP_SERVER credential for the Comet Backup MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_SESSION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the COMET_BACKUP_SESSION_KEY credential for the Comet Backup MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Set the COMET_BACKUP_USERNAME credential for the Comet Backup MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Full https URL of your Comet Server (for example https://10.0.0.5:8060). Overrides COMET_BACKUP_SERVER when set.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and nothing is written to the local store.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to your Comet Server.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_BACKUP_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
